def is_costas(perm):
    n = len(perm)
    vectors = set()
    for c1 in range(n):
        for c2 in range(c1+1, n):
            dr = perm[c2] - perm[c1]
            dc = c2 - c1
            if (dc, dr) in vectors:
                return False
            vectors.add((dc, dr))
    return True
